scope: Build actual conditional-teacher source data; no model fit/current inference/PnP in this pilot. Not native8 or human semantic gold.

root_actual_RGB_review.approval_reason: These fixed regions contain visually associated exposed target outline/body-corner cues in source RGB; M4 shape boundary is a sanity check only. Original xy/bbox are not moved.
root_actual_RGB_review.rank2: U: fixed region has no visible target ownership; floor cue association unsupported.
root_actual_RGB_review.rank3: U pending additional actual interior-rim association review; no M0 outline alone is not evidence of absence.

jitter.L: verbatim original_side_L, input-only original initializer recipe; never GT recentered/rescaled
jitter.rule: q=q0+delta*L; reference xy/uncertainty/state unchanged. Stress4 excluded from any primary D/E training admission.
jitter.scale_basis: Source initializer residual p75 normalized .10991 supports a fixed rounded .125 grid; not selected from current223 or source model results. .75L is a prespecified MISS diagnostic, not a training radius.

interventions.original: preserve root reviewed conditional D only for ranks0/4/5/7; other four remain U
interventions.full_cover: One distinct YCB TRAIN visible-object cutout placed as a known opaque front layer; every native uncertainty cell alpha==1 => conditional Eteacher
interventions.partial_cover: shift same cutout to mixed alpha0/1 over uncertainty => underlying U; no fraction threshold promoted to E
interventions.query_only_negative_control: If a preexisting jitter-grid q can be covered while all fixed uncertainty cells stay alpha0, layer there retains Dteacher. Nonfeasible controls are explicit skipped, never relocated references.
interventions.donor_selection: YCB TRAIN target rows sorted SHA256(id), first4; no score/appearance/fit results. Each target/reference uses its rank modulo4. No source validation donor.
interventions.cutout_scaling: nearest binary alpha; full cropped visible-instance RGB, minimum maxbbox side .25L, enlarge as needed for inscribed-square core to cover uncertainty+4nativepixel margin; certify actual alpha after integer translation, fixed original box/L.

label_rules.semantic: reference-state independent of q; Dteacher/Eteacher/U only, natural SELF unsupported and never manufactured from masks
label_rules.availability: reuse bound V69 conservative half-open rectangle math FULL/PARTIAL/MISS/INVALID on actual image footprint
label_rules.training_target: D/E only at FULL for primary9 and approved conditional refs; other states U. stress4 training target U even if FULL.
label_rules.native_exact_r2: separate original/composite M4 query support audits; do not determine reference-state labels
label_rules.ID_fields: row IDs and file paths are loader lineage only, not model features

split: All existing SYNTH references and all donors TRAIN; no independent VAL. All jitter/composite siblings share sourceframe/reference/donor family. Pilot data do not authorize model selection/current comparison.
identifiability: Audit actual full permitted RGB/q/L/box and effective RGBcrop/valid/q/L/box byte hashes for contradictory D/E states; audit nearby hidden references separately. No finite-sample collision does not prove global semantic identifiability.
